title: STARTTLS advertised in EHLO when configured, handler always returns 454
description: Trigger: TLS cert_path and key_path are set in config. EHLO response includes '250-STARTTLS'. Client sends STARTTLS. Behavior: server returns '454 TLS not available' regardless. load_tls_config() in tls.rs is never called from server.rs or session.rs — the loaded config is only validated, never applied. An MTA that requires STARTTLS (STARTTLS-policy or MTA-STS) will fail delivery after seeing the advertisement. RFC 3207 says 454 means temporary failure; advertising STARTTLS and immediately 454-ing it looks like a broken server. Fix: remove STARTTLS from EHLO advertisement until actual STARTTLS negotiation is implemented. The config validation and load_tls_config code can stay; just don't advertise what you can't do.
